blocks.text: Why your carrier database feels like a full time job

The freight broker carrier database is the heart of your brokerage. When it is messy, your entire operation slows down. Most brokers struggle because they treat the database as a static list. In reality, carrier compliance and safety ratings change daily. If you are not monitoring these changes, you are taking on hidden risk.

The biggest drain is the manual nature of the work. You receive an email with a rate confirmation. You open your TMS. You copy the carrier name, then the zip code, then the rate. You do this twenty times a day. This is not just boring. It is a massive tax on your time.
The real cost of manual maintenance

When you calculate the cost of database maintenance, do not just look at the software subscription. Look at the labor. If you spend 10 hours a week on manual entry, you are effectively paying yourself to be a data processor, not a broker. That is time you are not spending on the phone with shippers or negotiating better rates.
How to fix your workflow without buying new tools

items: Use browser bookmarks for your most-visited carrier vetting pages.
Standardize your email subject lines to make searching for carrier documents easier.
Use keyboard shortcuts in Chrome to switch between your TMS and your email tabs.
Create a template for common carrier onboarding emails to reduce typing time.
Clean your database once a month by removing inactive or non-compliant carriers.

blocks.text: Using Lazur to manage your carrier data

Lazur works with your existing web-based TMS. Since you are likely using Chrome or Safari to run your freight software, Lazur can help you navigate those pages faster. You do not need to switch platforms to get help.

faq.question: Can Lazur update my TMS automatically?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons or edit data for you. It helps you by answering questions, pointing at elements on your screen, and dictating text.

faq.question: Is my carrier data safe with Lazur?
faq.answer: Yes. Lazur only sees your screen when you hold the shortcut key. Your data is not stored or used to train AI models.

faq.question: Does Lazur work with legacy Windows software?
faq.answer: Lazur runs on macOS. If you use virtualization software like Parallels to run Windows apps, Lazur can see the screen, but it works best with web-based TMS platforms.

costs.title: Compliance risk

causes.title: Fragmented systems
causes.text: Using separate tools for email, load boards, and TMS makes it hard to keep data in one place.

causes.title: High carrier turnover
causes.text: The industry sees many new carriers enter and exit the market, requiring constant monitoring.

causes.title: Unstructured data
causes.text: Carrier documents arrive in many formats, making it difficult to extract information quickly.

fixes.title: Use browser bookmarks
fixes.text: Organize your essential carrier vetting links in a folder in your browser for quick access.

fixes.title: Standardize data entry
fixes.text: Create a simple checklist for what needs to be recorded for every new carrier to avoid missed steps.

fixes.title: Monthly database audit
fixes.text: Set a recurring calendar event to clean up your carrier list once a month to remove inactive entries.
